facts.fact: The Plan minister announced on 1 June 2026 the official launch of recruitment of census-cartography agents for RGPH-2 and general enumeration in July 2027.

The Plan minister cited published results of the Demographic and Health Survey EDS III RDC 2024, showing under-18s are 56% of the population; the release date is not given, so the survey year is used.
